candidates.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image is Karolina's authoritative character design: preserve her identity, colors and core clothing symbols only, while drastically changing proportions. Create ONE super-cute very compact CHIBI DESKTOP PET on a truly transparent RGBA background. SINGLE complete standing figure; not a sheet, no labels. Much shorter and rounder than a standard anime chibi: broad oversized head, tiny short body, very short stubby legs and tiny mitten-like hands, no adult body proportions. Keep plum-to-lavender fluffy hair, asymmetrical dark/white/violet large bow upper-left, simplified braid right, subtly pointed ears, violet eyes with small cyan/pink glints, black short cape, white inner blouse, compact asymmetric dark violet skirt with just 2-3 triangular seams and few tiny node accents, mismatched legwear with one dark stocking and ONE short white sock, tiny rounded mechanical boots. All costume detail must read at 96px height. Simplify hair into a few large flowing masses, never long thin strands; cape and skirt compact and softly flared. ABSOLUTELY REMOVE the smartphone/phone from her body, belt and hands. No Small K face or facial screen anywhere in the figure, no terminal, phone, tablet, robot, separate mascot, shoulder companion, hanging gadget. Modest covered stylized costume. Keep the silhouette and face more important than decorative density. No whale/fish costume, tail, fins, maid outfit, scarf, glasses or headphones. No scenery, floor, background, window, laptop, props, text, watermark, checkerboard or second character. Full head, bow, hands and feet in frame, use the full vertical space without huge empty borders. STYLE A — soft premium 2D anime chibi, approximately TWO HEADS TALL in total, head 52% of complete body height. Very round cheeks, a tiny mouth, wide sparkling but refined eyes, soft painted cel shading with clean gently colored outlines, pastel lilac and restrained cyan/pink accents. Body like a compact little bell, shoulders and legs extremely short. Hands relaxed out to sides, head tilted slightly, sweet reserved half-smile. Hair fluffy and chunky, smooth gentle color gradients. Soft and warm visual feeling, crisp sprite silhouette, subtle local shading only; no dense glitter, intricate jewel material or metallic shine.
